cross_topic_interfaces.Corbel_to_Column: Column must provide reinforcement to receive corbel main tensile tension lap, compression anchorage, and two additional links near corbel top — column detailer needs corbel geometry/forces.
cross_topic_interfaces.Nib_to_SupportingBeam: Supporting beam's link design and effective depth (d) must account for the nib's vertical link leg and reduced concrete contribution — beam detailer needs nib geometry/loads.
cross_topic_interfaces.HalfJoint_to_SupportedMember: Bearing pad design (out of scope here) and supported member's reinforcement continuity must align with half joint tension anchorage/lap positions.
cross_topic_interfaces.PrestressedSlab_to_Column: Un-tensioned reinforcement at flat-slab columns must coordinate with column reinforcement and punching-shear detailing (not in this extract).
cross_topic_interfaces.PrestressedElement_to_GeneralDetailing: Nominal cover for durability (non-bond) still follows general slab/beam cover rules (§6.2/6.3, not in this extract).
cross_topic_interfaces.WaterRetainingWall_to_Foundation: Joint positions and reinforcement continuity at wall/base junctions depend on the (separate) foundation detailing chapter — not included here.
